body:
Quick update: an initial investigation seems to indicate that the ESM5 browser.js is not being processed at all. Or at least the NgModule aspect of this file is not being processed, which is why the decorator is not being removed.

Other files containing NgModule decorators are being processed.

@alan-agius4 Can you cherry-pick f13fb367e03983fd2e11f7cf344162b1c78c5962 from #26947 and see if that resolves the issue? We are aware of inconsistent behavior in the ESM5 reflection host which should have been accounted for in that commit, possibly resolving this issue (?)

@JoostK, thanks for your tip, though that commit doesn't have any effect on this issue.

As @petebacondarwin mentioned it looks that certain files are not being processed at all.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/17563226/50480227-f8035800-09da-11e9-8b27-df016abd5700.png)

Note: that there are no `.bak` files for certain files.

# 🐞 bug report

### Affected Package
`StaticInjector` in `@angular/core`

### Description

When adding the `RouterModule` and use `ngtsc`, together with the usual `platformBrowserDynamic` bootstrapping code causes a runtime error.


## 🔬 Minimal Reproduction
```
git clone https://github.com/alan-agius4/ivy-router-issue.git
npm i
node_modules\.bin\ivy-ngcc
ng serve --prod
```

## 🔥 Exception or Error
Runtime error:
```
core.js:15268 ERROR TypeError: Cannot read property '__source' of undefined
    at t.get (core.js:8532)
    at t.get (core.js:8894)
    at core.js:1207
    at Ne (core.js:1207)
    at Object.t_Factory [as factory] (ngInjectableDef.js:8)
    at t.hydrate (core.js:9017)
    at t.get (core.js:8888)
    at core.js:1207
    at Ne (core.js:1207)
    at Fe (core.js:1264)
```

At first glace, it doesn't look like this is a CLI issue as disabling Optimizations and Build Optimizer, yields the same result.
